decision: B host output validator with fixed NES/host phase-RAM ports is the next structural boundary, not an adopted optimization. Offline byte and ownership results cannot establish whole area or retimed throughput.
next_action: Prototype only the fixed-port host-output boundary with actual removal of descriptor byte RPC, local-event/continuation mux and both output data mailboxes; retain source codec/query, queue/staging/plan credits, independent coverage, STOP and final ACK. Charge deferred source mask write, serial host receipt RAM, CRC and grant/return. Same whole Lite MAP target region2724comb before placement margin; retime actual ARM refill/IRQ/polling/ROM/CPU stream to recover at least1.280ms plus new costs beyond optimistic parser credit. No isolated opcode/FSM/FIT-seed loops; no P2/physical claim.
summary: NES277: 원본 payload 한 번 읽기 모델로71프레임/1231패킷의 metadata·receipt·CRC와544개 기존CPU trace를 대조했다. host 출력 실행기와고정 RAM 포트 경계를 정했으나 새RTL/MAP/일정 검증은 아니다. 954 parser 전체0 민감도도17.946626ms로1.279959ms 부족; 실제276 기준1.555478ms/2837comb 부족 유지. STOP·ACK·포트 계약71개 모델 거절 사례 PASS. 최적화 채택/P2는 보류한다.
